items.title: Louis Cottrell, Jr. Interview, 1961-08-25
items.q: I was born in 1911. I began studying with T.O. in 1922.

ctx.x: well come back, you don't know it that well this time. Uh-huh. That's about, what year now did you study with him? Let's see, you were born 1911.
I was born in 1911. I began studying with T.O. in 1922.
22? Yeah. Quite young. And you say that first you had the soft edge. Yes. How long did he keep you on soft edge? Well that was your father. My father had me on soft edge. Oh, but did T.O. also?
